versions.changelog: v2.0: Rewritten trigger script with meaningful SKILL.md generation from transcripts, proper workspace paths, v2 lifecycle manager
v1.0.2: Updated documentation with secure usage patterns (stdin piping), added install.json spec, clarified security best practices. No code changes - only documentation improvements.

SECURITY FIX v1.0.1: Configurable workspace path via AUTO_SKILL_WORKSPACE env var. No sensitive data persistence - session IDs are hashed, transcripts are not written to disk. Added path validation and permission checks.

Auto-skill-extractor v1.0.0 — initial release

- Automatically detects and extracts reusable skills from subagent workflow patterns
- Scores subagent completions for complexity, then drafts, promotes, or archives skills based on usage
- Prevents overwriting, ensures name sanitization, and manages skill lifecycle (draft → auto → archive)
- CLI and Python triggers for integration, manual control, promotion, and curation
- Designed to grow your skill library organically from real agent usage and reduce manual skill authoring
